statement: The visible product is DocForge and is presented as a general Markdown-to-Word document workbench.
Open, save, validate, template selection, build, preview, Office PDF selection, and cancellation retain their transport behavior.
The desktop workbench presents outline, Markdown editor, Microsoft Word preview, diagnostics, and output state in the approved hierarchy.
The mobile workbench exposes outline, editor, preview, and diagnostics without horizontal overflow.
The UI redesign does not introduce a dependency into parser, domain, compiler, RenderPlan, or DOCX renderer layers.
